name: Todoist
whatYouLose: Natural-language date parsing that just works in every language
Native apps on every platform with instant sync and reminders
Widgets, watch apps and email forwarding into your inbox
prompt:
Build a keyboard-first todo app as an installable PWA, a Todoist replacement for one person.

Stack: Vite + vanilla TS, IndexedDB for storage, optional sync to a tiny Node + SQLite endpoint.
Features:
- Quick add with natural language: "pay rent every 1st #home p1" → recurring task, project, priority.
- Inbox, Today, Upcoming views; projects and labels.
- Recurring tasks, subtasks, drag to reorder.
- Push notifications for reminders (service worker + Web Push).
- Keyboard shortcuts for everything (q add, j/k move, e complete), command palette.
- Works offline; installable on phone home screens.
Done when: the PWA installs on a phone, works offline and fires a reminder.
notes: A good todo PWA is very buildable. Native widgets and bulletproof sync across devices are the gap.
